endorsements.name: Charlie Lindholm
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-12381
endorsements.description:
Improper Privilege Management vulnerability in AlgoSec Firewall Analyzer on Linux, 64 bit allows Privilege Escalation, Parameter Injection.

A local user with access to the command line may escalate their privileges by abusing the parameters of a command that is approved in the sudoers file. 
This issue affects Firewall Analyzer: A33.0, A33.10.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 6.1)

endorsements.name: Charlie Lindholm
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-12382
endorsements.description: Improper Limitation of a Pathname 'Path Traversal') vulnerability in Algosec Firewall Analyzer on Linux, 64 bit allows an authenticated user to upload files to a restricted directory leading to code injection. This issue affects Algosec Firewall Analyzer: A33.0 (up to build 320), A33.10 (up to build 210).
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 7.3)
